literal: Having discerned the appropriate time, and having understood well, let them speak, those of goodness who have known the nature of speech.
translation: Let those of good character, who know the nature of speech, discern the right opportunity and understand their audience thoroughly before they speak.
modern: சொல்லின் தன்மையை அறிந்த நற்குணமுடையவர்கள், பேசுவதற்கு ஏற்ற நேரத்தை ஆராய்ந்து, அவையினரின் தன்மையை நன்றாக உணர்ந்து பேச வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the essential qualities of effective communication. The poet advises that people of good character who understand the power and nature of words ('சொல்லின் நடை தெரிந்த நன்மையவர்') must speak with great care. They must first identify the right opportunity or timing ('இடை தெரிந்து') and then thoroughly comprehend the nature of their audience ('நன்கு உணர்ந்து'). Only when both the timing and the audience's disposition are favorable should they deliver their speech.
